artifacts.verification_method: Each selected field and every used code value must cite an authoritative source identity and preserved evidence location before predicates are defined.
artifacts.blocker: The semantic package remains partially bound. The candidate's OP_AUTH_TYPE and OP_AUTH_STATUS semantics are supported by the preserved, digest-bound USDOT MOTUS Operating Authority Data Dictionary; no point-in-time MOTUS join is preserved and temporal alignment remains unresolved.
